dimensions.label: Runtime isolation
dimensions.rationale: The frozen ledger records denominators only. The site browser check provides current numerator evidence: 70 of 70 homepage destinations completed and external_requests is empty.

dimensions.label: Review contract
dimensions.rationale: The clone-local review journey is exercised by browser_check.py and test_app.py. The authenticated source submission terminal remains unavailable because no source write was performed.

dimensions.label: Searchable beer catalog
dimensions.sampling_method: Deterministic full-population search-result and detail-route assertions for every entry in candidate.beers in materials/beeradvocate/clone/tests/test_app.py.
dimensions.rationale: The candidate test suite searches for and opens the detail route of each of the 240 local entities. This does not claim that the synthetic catalog is a complete BeerAdvocate source catalog.
